files.title: Glass (clean, amp only)
files.description: Built-in clean capture for amp slot 1
files.author: Sean Snaider
files.notes: Trained from BellyDSP's own gray-box reference amp (prototypes/amp_sim.py, clean channel, gain 4, bass 5, mid 5, treble 6, master 5; amp only, no cab) with neural-amp-modeler 0.12.3, standard WaveNet, 100 epochs, validation ESR 0.0002; a stand-in until Sean's own captures

files.title: Ember (crunch, amp only)
files.description: Built-in crunch capture for amp slot 2
files.author: Sean Snaider
files.notes: Trained from BellyDSP's own gray-box reference amp (prototypes/amp_sim.py, crunch channel, gain 5, bass 5, mid 6, treble 5, master 5; amp only, no cab) with neural-amp-modeler 0.12.3, standard WaveNet, 100 epochs, validation ESR 0.0006; a stand-in until Sean's own captures

files.title: Monolith (high gain, amp only)
files.description: Built-in high-gain capture for amp slot 3
files.author: Sean Snaider
files.notes: Trained from BellyDSP's own gray-box reference amp (prototypes/amp_sim.py, lead channel, gain 4, bass 4, mid 6, treble 6, master 5, after the app's Screamer boost at +6 dB; amp only, no cab) with neural-amp-modeler 0.12.3, standard WaveNet, 200 epochs, validation ESR 0.0033; a stand-in until Sean's own captures
